HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Con.]
Painful sensitiveness of hearing ; noise startles, deafness follows.
Ringing, singing, humming, buzzing and roaring in ears.
Tingling in ears.
Obstruction of ears ; feel stopped up, when blowing nose.
Hardness of hearing.
In inner ear, sharp shocks from within outward when swallowing, and piercing pains and aching ; painful tension behind ear, and piercing pains in mastoid process.
Drawing stitching in ear from within outward.
Tearing and stitching in and about ears.
Pinching pain in right ear. θ Uterine disorder.
Hardness of hearing, ceasing when wax is removed, returning as wax again accumulates.
Accumulation of earwax, looking blood red, or like decayed paper, with pus or mucus.
Tumors and boils behind ears.
Parotid glands swollen and hard.
Suppuration of left parotid with profuse sweat, disturbing sleep. θ Diabetes.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Con.]
Excessively acute sense of smell.
Boring in nostrils ; smell of animals in back part of nose.
Constantly picks his nose, which bleeds easily. θ Mental derangement.
Troublesome feeling of dryness in nose.
Tingling in nose, frequent sneezing, with watery, slimy discharge.
Stinging soreness and itching at tip and inside of nose.
Pain deep in root of nose before menses, < from panting or pressure ; discharge of blood and pus from nose.
Ozæna, with burning in nostrils and stitching pain in nasal septum, discharge of pus and blood from nose ; after abuse of mercury.
Fluent coryza. θ Cough.
Flow of acrid mucus from nose. θ Inflammation of eyes.
Purulent discharge from nose ; also hardened crusts.
Epistaxis.
Nosebleed : with suppressed menses, from taking cold ; frequent ebullitions of blood ; from slightest cause ; in Spring ; after sneezing.
Frequent excessive sneezing.
Obstruction of nostrils of long standing.
Inflammation of nose with bleeding from right side, after abuse of mercury.
Fibrous polypi, hard and elastic, pricking and itching after touching or handling ; excessively acute smell, with purulent discharge.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Con.]
Sickly and pale complexion.
Face : earthy, yellow ; reddish-yellow ; pale ; sallow ; bluish ; purple ; bloated.
Face flushed. θ Whooping cough.
Heat in face with congestion of blood.
Heat of face, congestion to head, with catarrhal sensation.
Itching in face.
Drawing, extending from jaws to ears and head.
Stinging tearing faceache, at night.
Lacerating in right half of face.
Itching pimples in face.
Gnawing ulcers in face, or moist and spreading herpes.
Eruption of small and large pustules on right cheek. θ Inflammation of eyes.
Ulcers on face and lips ; cancer of cheek ; spreading cancerous ulcers ; cancerous tumors of lips and face.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Con.]
Pressure and compression above lips.
Lips and tongue dry and sticky.
Lips and teeth covered with black crusts.
Lips : burning ; shooting in them ; dry and scaly.
Blisters, or eruption on lips.
Induration of lymphatics of lip after contusion.
Cancer of lips ; from pressure of pipe.
Submaxillary glands swollen and hard.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Con.]
Gnashing of teeth.
Jerking pain in teeth ; seem loose during mastication.
Violent drawing toothache ; teeth feel loose.
Drawing pain in sound teeth when walking in open air.
Drawing in a hollow tooth, when eating cold things or from cold drink.
Darting pains in teeth, < from eating and drinking.
Stitching pain in teeth.
Teeth and lips covered with black crusts.
Drawing pains and fine stitches in gums and teeth.
Gums swollen, blue-red and bleed readily.
